about: Port specifications for the devices in My Collection and about 300 popular pedals. Signal Flow uses a device's ports from here instead of the generic set. Ports, connectors and power were researched from manufacturer pages, manuals and retailer spec sheets (see each device's notes and sources); "verified" stays false until you've checked a device against the real unit.

devices.name: EV-30 Dual Expression Pedal
devices.notes: Passive dual expression pedal, no power needed. Outputs are isolated; polarity switch and range per output.

devices.name: NS-1X Noise Suppressor
devices.notes: Send/Return loop puts noisy pedals inside the suppressor. Has a DC OUT jack for chaining power (needs a BOSS PSA adapter and PCS-20A cable), not modeled.

devices.name: Protein V3 (Green)
devices.notes: Draw listed as under 30 mA by Browne and most retailers (one retailer says under 100 mA). Top-mounted jacks.

devices.name: T4
devices.notes: Fuzz. Spec is 'less than 100 mA' (a retailer table says 10 mA); 100 mA used to be safe. No battery.

devices.name: Big Time
devices.notes: Stereo, balanced or unbalanced I/O (TRS jacks assumed), full-size MIDI DIN in (clock, PC, CC), EXP/CV and AUX switch inputs. ~1 A. Exact jack labels not confirmed; check the manual.

devices.name: Blooper
devices.notes: Mono I/O, ~150 mA. EXP/CV jack for expression or CV clock; TAP/MIDI TRS jack takes a MIDIbox (Ring Active) or tap switch.

devices.name: Brothers AM
devices.notes: Mono, true bypass, ~200 mA. Jack layout assumed from Chase Bliss's two-footswitch format (EXP/CV and MIDI TRS jacks).

devices.name: Clean
devices.notes: Manual: 9V ~300 mA. Mono or stereo I/O on TRS jacks; separate sidechain input on the side.

devices.name: Dark World
devices.notes: Mono in/out, ~200 mA. MIDI jack is TRS (also controls the left footswitch via the tip).

devices.name: MOOD
devices.notes: Original (MKI) MOOD: mono. ~150 mA per a compiled current-draw table (a resale listing says ~200 mA); use a 200 mA+ output. Not an official figure.

devices.name: MOOD MKII (Light Bright)
devices.notes: Manual: 9V at least 270 mA. In/Out are TRS for stereo, TS for mono. MIDI needs a Chase Bliss MIDIbox; the MIDI/EXT jack also takes a momentary footswitch. CV range 0-5V.

devices.name: Reverse Mode C
devices.notes: Stereo I/O including mono splitting, ~270 mA. Same jack format as MOOD MKII (assumed).

devices.name: Thermae
devices.notes: Manual: consumes ~180 mA, use a supply of 200 mA or more (a 100 mA outlet won't work). EXP/CV: tip to wiper, or 0-5V CV on tip.

devices.name: Warped Vinyl HiFi
devices.notes: Mono, ~100 mA. MIDI (PC, CC, clock) via MIDIbox on the TRS MIDI jack; external tap supported.

devices.name: Circle Looper
devices.notes: Draws 300 mA; Donner says use a 9V center-negative adapter of 500 mA or more. Ext Ctrl is a TRS jack for a dual footswitch. Micro USB for importing/exporting loops.

devices.name: POG2
devices.notes: 160-180 mA (sources vary; 180 used). EHX supplies a 9.6V 200 mA adapter; runs on 9-9.6V DC center negative, no battery. Separate Dry Out.

devices.name: Buffer+
devices.notes: 86 mA. Serial effects loop (send/return), tuner out independent of the mute (can be a second output or DI).

devices.name: Compressor MKII (Blue Sparkle)
devices.notes: 100 mA at 9V (one retailer says 9-18V; check the manual before using 18V). Sidechain is a 3.5mm TRS send/return jack.

devices.name: Heavy
devices.notes: 200 mA at 9V DC center negative (the Heavy Menace is a different pedal at 250 mA).

devices.name: Zoia
devices.notes: 300 mA. Stereo pair of TS inputs (Hi-Z) and TS line outputs; one TRS control port for CV, expression or an external switch; 3.5mm TRS MIDI in/out (dongles included).

devices.name: VP
devices.notes: Passive, no power. Specs found are for the VP Jr 250k (TS input, output and tuner out); confirm which VP model this is.

devices.name: H9
devices.notes: 500 mA at 9V, supply included. Sources disagree on barrel polarity (center positive vs negative); use the Eventide supply or check the label. Mini USB for H9 Control and MIDI.

devices.name: H9 (Dark)
devices.notes: Same I/O and power as the H9. 500 mA at 9V; polarity listed inconsistently, so use the Eventide supply or check the label.

devices.name: H90 Harmonizer
devices.notes: Eventide spec: 12V DC 600 mA (or 9V DC 800 mA), center POSITIVE 5.5/2.5mm jack; supplied 12V 1A adapter. Four TS inputs and outputs, each instrument or line level. EXP/CTL jacks take expression pedals, 0-5V CV or aux switches.

devices.name: Hors d'Oeuvre?
devices.notes: 30 mA at 9V center negative, no battery. Has a CV input for modulating feedback (sequencer or expression pedal); its jack type isn't documented in the sources found.

devices.name: OCD
devices.notes: About 8 mA (V2). Runs on 9-18V DC center negative; 18V gives more headroom. Fulltone recommends a regulated supply.

devices.name: Plimsoul
devices.notes: About 12 mA (from resale listings, not Fulltone). Runs on 9-18V DC center negative.

devices.name: Motor Pedal
devices.notes: Needs 9V center negative, at least 500 mA. Track In lets the motor follow another source in the chain; Track Out passes that signal on. MIDI connector type not confirmed.

devices.name: Plasma
devices.notes: 300 mA at 9V center negative (max; typical ~100 mA, 2.8 mA in bypass). Size the supply for 300 mA. TS in/out.

devices.name: Recoder
devices.notes: Official: 9V DC center negative, 500 mA minimum. All jacks mono. REC Out/In form a buffered loop. MIDI in over 3.5mm TRS Type B or USB-C; no MIDI out.

devices.name: Specular Tempus
devices.notes: ~100 mA. 1/4in TS audio in/out (stereo), 1/8in effects loop (TS or TRS). Aux In for 1-3 button footswitches; Aux Out is a tempo/switch output. MIDI In covers tap and expression.

devices.name: Lightspeed
devices.notes: 11 mA at 9V. Runs on 9-18V DC center negative (18V: more headroom). Internal 9V battery clip.

devices.name: Chroma Console
devices.notes: Stereo, instrument or line level. MIDI over DIN and USB-C. 500 mA at 9V center negative per ModularGrid (supply included); Hologram's page gives no figure. Jack split (L/R pairs, DIN in vs out) assumed.

devices.name: Microcosm
devices.notes: Manual: 9V center negative, supply must provide at least 400 mA; avoid daisy chains and switching supplies (noise). One TRS input (stereo set in Global Config), separate L/R outputs. EXP tip 0-3V.

devices.name: Ampero Press (25kΩ Edition)
devices.notes: Passive, no power. 100k volume pot on the TS in/out; independent 25k expression pot on a TRS EXP output (made for Ampero II Stomp; check the target's EXP impedance).

devices.name: Wong Press
devices.notes: Max 30 mA at 9V (or 9V battery). Volume / wah / expression / volume+wah modes; separate tuner and expression (10k) outputs. Jack types not stated; TS audio and TRS expression assumed.

devices.name: TONEX One
devices.notes: 120 mA at 9V center negative, or USB-C bus power. TRS output: stereo, dual mono or headphones. USB-C is also an audio interface. No MIDI jacks on the standard One (the One+ adds mini TRS MIDI).

devices.name: AT+
devices.notes: 15 mA. Runs on 9-18V DC center negative (18V for more headroom); don't exceed 18V.

devices.name: Bonsai
devices.notes: About 20 mA (spec ceiling under 100 mA). 9V only, center negative; no battery.

devices.name: Morning Glory V4
devices.notes: 43 mA, 9V only (don't exceed 9V). Remote jack takes a JHS Red Remote (momentary switch) to toggle the high gain mode.

devices.name: PackRat
devices.notes: About 100 mA per a community current-draw table (no official figure found). JHS says 9V only unless stated otherwise.

devices.name: Halo
devices.notes: 160 mA at 9V center negative. Stereo in/out on separate jacks; TRS expression and TRS remote (tap / preset) jacks.

devices.name: Blues Power
devices.notes: Most sellers list 100 mA (RockBoard lists 64 mA); 100 mA used. 9V DC center negative.

devices.name: The Duellist
devices.notes: V3: 10 mA, 9-18V DC; older V2 listed under 100 mA. 100 mA used until the version is confirmed.

devices.name: Helix
devices.notes: Mains powered (IEC cable, internal supply), so no pedal-supply jack is listed. Also has S/PDIF and AES/EBU digital I/O, VDI (Variax) and L6 LINK, not modeled. Jack list from retailer specs and the Line 6 forum; the manual's back-panel page is an image, so check labels against your unit.

devices.name: HX Stomp
devices.notes: Rear panel marked 9VDC 3A; Line 6 recommends its DC-3G supply. 3000 mA used so a pedal supply output isn't overloaded. Send is one TRS jack (mono or stereo); Return L/Mono doubles as Aux In. EXP 1/2 takes a dual expression pedal or extra footswitches. USB is an audio interface.

devices.name: EVH 5150 Overdrive
devices.notes: 12.5 mA bypassed, 14.5 mA on with gate engaged. 9V adapter or battery.

devices.name: Duke of Tone
devices.notes: Manual: 6 mA at 9V DC; no battery. Marketing copy mentions 18V for more headroom (not in the manual).

devices.name: RevivalDRIVE
devices.notes: Big-box RevivalDRIVE: 120 mA at 9V center negative, no battery (the Compact draws 100 mA). Comes with an external footswitch for channel switching; footswitch jack type assumed TRS.

devices.name: Strobostomp Mini
devices.notes: 85 mA nominal at 9V center negative, or 5V USB-C bus power. No power output.

devices.name: Digit
devices.notes: No Digit-specific current figure found; 150 mA is the sister Beebo's spec (shared firmware), so check before relying on it. Stereo I/O (one write-up says 4 in / 4 out). MIDI in/out on TRS with 5-pin DIN adapters supplied.

devices.name: Bitmap 2
devices.notes: Stereo TRS in/out. CTRL jack takes an expression pedal, remote switch, remote tap or MIDI. No current figure found; 250 mA assumed from the Raster 2 (same platform).

devices.name: Raster 2
devices.notes: 250 mA at 9V center negative. Stereo TRS in/out. CTRL jack (listed as 1/4in TS by one retailer) takes expression, remote, tap or MIDI; MIDI also over USB.

devices.name: NU-33 Vinyl Engine
devices.notes: Official: 9V DC center negative, 60 mA. Assignable expression/CV input. Top-mounted jacks.

devices.name: EQ2
devices.notes: 180 mA at 9V. Stereo in/out, 3.5mm control input (Source Audio expression pedal, tap switch or Neuro Hub), 5-pin MIDI In and Thru. Newer units have USB-MIDI.

devices.name: Conduit
devices.notes: MIDI hub: opto-isolated 5-pin DIN in and out, four bi-directional 1/4in TRS MIDI ports (each set independently), USB-C. 50 mA at 9V, or USB bus power.

devices.name: Iridium
devices.notes: Manual: 9V DC center negative, 500 mA minimum. TRS input (mono, or stereo via TRS). EXP/MIDI jack takes an expression pedal, footswitch, or MIDI via Strymon MIDI EXP cable. USB Mini-B for IRs and firmware.

devices.name: Mini Switch
devices.notes: Passive single footswitch, no power. 1/4in TRS (cable included). Internal jumper: Favorite/Boost or Tap Tempo mode.

devices.name: Ojai
devices.notes: Official: 5 isolated 9V 500 mA outputs, no voltage switch. Runs from 24V DC: the included PS-124 adapter, or a Zuma/Zuma R300 24V link. 24V Thru links more Ojai units. The 24V In draw (1000 mA) is a placeholder, not a published figure.

devices.name: Zuma
devices.notes: Official: 9 isolated outputs, 48W max. Per the owner: outputs 1-6 fixed 9V 500 mA; outputs 7 and 8 switchable 9V 500 mA / 12V 275 mA / 18V 250 mA; output 9 is a fixed 24V link that powers an Ojai/Ojai R30 (its 1000 mA is a placeholder, not a published figure). Mains via IEC cable (100-240V).

devices.name: Zuma R300
devices.notes: Official: 5 isolated outputs, 36W max. Outputs 1-4 fixed 9V 500 mA; output 5 switchable 9V 500 mA / 12V 375 mA / 18V 250 mA. 24V Thru links an Ojai/Ojai R30. Mains via IEC cable.

devices.name: Polytune 3
devices.notes: 100 mA in most listings (one says 45 mA). True bypass or buffered (switchable). A user review mentions a DC output for powering another pedal; not confirmed in specs, so not modeled.

devices.name: Polytune 3 Mini
devices.notes: Thomann lists 40 mA; ModularGrid and RockBoard list 100 mA. 100 mA used to be safe.

devices.name: Spark Mini Booster
devices.notes: No published figure for the Mini; the full-size Spark Booster draws 16-20 mA, so 20 mA is an estimate. 9V center negative.

devices.name: Sansamp GT2
devices.notes: Tech 21 manual: about 4 mA. Use a 9V DC supply rated 100 mA minimum, 2.1mm center negative (or a 9V battery; plugging into the input turns it on).

devices.name: Imperial Preamp
devices.notes: Tri-tube preamp (Tone King, not King Tone). Manual: DC input 9V to 12V, needs >= 9W; ships with a 12V adapter, so 12V 750 mA here (about 1 A at 9V). Plug polarity isn't stated in the manual: center negative is assumed, check the adapter. Stereo master effects loop (Send, Return L/R; use L for mono). Balanced XLR outs L/R with ground lift carry the IR / power amp sim. To Amp In is a true-bypass output, active only when bypassed; From Amp Send / To Amp Return add the Imperial as a channel of an amp through its loop (To Amp Return always active, also usable as a power amp feed). Headphones out. MIDI In only (no Thru/Out), default channel Omni. USB-C for the editor, updates and audio streaming.

devices.name: GP-5
devices.notes: 100 mA on 9V center negative (190 mA on USB 5V bus power). TRS output is stereo line out and headphone out. USB-C: audio interface, files, firmware. MIDI unconfirmed (listings conflict), not modeled.

devices.name: EP Booster
devices.notes: Official: 9V DC, 5 mA. Accepts 9-18V for more headroom. 9V battery option.

devices.name: DS-1 Distortion
devices.notes: 10 mA stated (about 4 mA measured). Battery or BOSS PSA adapter: 9V DC, center negative.

devices.name: TS9 Tube Screamer
devices.notes: 8 mA. 9V battery or 9V center-negative adapter (Ibanez AC509).

devices.name: TS808 Tubescreamer
devices.notes: 8 mA. 9V battery or 9V center-negative adapter.

devices.name: SD-1 Super Overdrive
devices.notes: 10 mA stated (about 5 mA measured). Battery or BOSS PSA adapter: 9V DC, center negative.

devices.name: BD-2 Blues Driver
devices.notes: 20 mA stated (about 13 mA measured). Battery or BOSS PSA adapter: 9V DC, center negative.

devices.name: Rat 2
devices.notes: About 3-5 mA (manual: 'about 5 mA is more than enough'). 9V battery or 9V negative-ground adapter. Don't use TRS cables.

devices.name: Big Muff Pi (Big Box)
devices.notes: About 3-5 mA. 9V battery or 9V center-negative 2.1mm adapter (EHX 9.6DC-200 recommended).

devices.name: TU-3 Chromatic Tuner
devices.notes: 20 mA, 80 mA in High Brightness mode. Bypass jack is an always-on thru output. Has a DC OUT jack to daisy-chain power to other pedals (PSA adapter and PCS-20A cable); daisy chains are drawn from the power jack instead. BOSS PSA adapter: 9V DC, center negative.

devices.name: Cry Baby Standard Wah
devices.notes: Under 1 mA (900 uA). Inputs labeled Instrument and Amplifier. 9V battery, Dunlop ECB003 adapter or DC Brick (9V, center negative).

devices.name: Phase 90
devices.notes: 5 mA stated (about 4 mA measured). 9V battery or Dunlop ECB003 adapter (9V, center negative).

devices.name: DD-8 Digital Delay
devices.notes: Stereo in/out. TEMPO/EXP jack (TRS) takes a tap switch or expression pedal. BOSS PSA adapter: 9V DC, center negative.

devices.name: DD-3 Digital Delay
devices.notes: Direct Out carries the dry signal (for a second amp). 35 mA stated; 45-58 mA measured depending on version. The later DD-3T adds a Tempo jack. BOSS PSA adapter: 9V DC, center negative.

devices.name: CH-1 Super Chorus
devices.notes: Output A/B for stereo. 55 mA stated (15 mA measured). BOSS PSA adapter: 9V DC, center negative.

devices.name: RC-1-BK Loop Station
devices.notes: Stereo looper. STOP/UNDO jack (TRS) for an external footswitch. BOSS PSA adapter: 9V DC, center negative.

devices.name: RC-5 Loop Station
devices.notes: Stereo looper. MIDI on 3.5mm TRS (stereo mini) jacks. STOP/MEMORY jack takes a footswitch or expression pedal. BOSS PSA adapter: 9V DC, center negative.

devices.name: Ditto Looper
devices.notes: Mono looper. 100 mA minimum (76 mA measured); 9V center negative, no battery. USB only for firmware updates, can't power it.

devices.name: Hall of Fame 2 Reverb
devices.notes: Stereo in/out. About 100 mA (87 mA measured; one retailer lists over 300 mA). 9V center negative.

devices.name: Flashback II Delay
devices.notes: Stereo in/out. Sources disagree on current (100 mA vs over 300 mA; 85 mA measured, but Crystal mode can trip a 100 mA output). 300 mA used here to be safe. 9V center negative.

devices.name: BigSky
devices.notes: Stereo in/out; Expression jack also takes a tap switch or MultiSwitch. 9V DC center negative, 300 mA minimum (Strymon); never more than 9V.

devices.name: Timeline
devices.notes: Right In/Out double as the feedback loop return/send when the rear Feedback Loop switch is on. MIDI Out can be set to Thru. 9V DC center negative, 300 mA minimum; never more than 9V.

devices.name: El Capistan v2
devices.notes: Single TRS input with a MONO/STEREO switch (stereo needs a TRS splitter cable); Out L/R (L alone for mono). EXP/MIDI jack takes a TRS expression pedal, MiniSwitch, MultiSwitch Plus or TRS MIDI. USB-C for MIDI and updates. 9V DC center negative, 300 mA minimum; never more than 9V.

devices.name: Flint v2
devices.notes: Single TRS input with a MONO/STEREO switch (stereo needs a TRS splitter cable); Out L/R (L alone for mono). EXP/MIDI jack takes a TRS expression pedal, MiniSwitch, MultiSwitch Plus or TRS MIDI. USB-C for MIDI and updates. 9V DC center negative, 300 mA minimum; never more than 9V.

devices.name: BlueSky v2
devices.notes: Single TRS input with a MONO/STEREO switch (stereo needs a TRS splitter cable); Out L/R (L alone for mono). EXP/MIDI jack takes a TRS expression pedal, MiniSwitch, MultiSwitch Plus or TRS MIDI. USB-C for MIDI and updates. 9V DC center negative, 300 mA minimum; never more than 9V.

devices.name: Deco v2
devices.notes: Single TRS input with a MONO/STEREO switch (stereo needs a TRS splitter cable); Out L/R (L alone for mono). EXP/MIDI jack takes a TRS expression pedal, MiniSwitch, MultiSwitch Plus or TRS MIDI. USB-C for MIDI and updates. 9V DC center negative, 300 mA minimum; never more than 9V.

devices.name: Mobius
devices.notes: Rear switch selects stereo or Pre/Post mode (Right In/Out become a second, separate path). 9V DC center negative, 300 mA minimum; never more than 9V.

devices.name: Volante
devices.notes: INST/LINE input switch. Expression jack also takes a tap switch, MultiSwitch Plus or 1/4"-to-MIDI cable. 300 mA minimum (263 mA listed elsewhere); never more than 9V.

devices.name: Brigadier
devices.notes: Original Brigadier: mono in, stereo out, expression jack. 9V DC center negative, 250 mA minimum; never more than 9V. (Strymon's current page describes a newer model with a single TRS in/out, EXP/MIDI and USB-C.)

devices.name: Sunset
devices.notes: Mono. Favorite jack takes a MiniSwitch; the Expression jack also carries MIDI with the MIDI EXP cable. 250 mA minimum (225 mA measured).

devices.name: Compadre
devices.notes: Mono. Volume jack takes an expression pedal as a volume pedal; Fav/MIDI jack takes a MiniSwitch, MultiSwitch Plus or the MIDI EXP cable. 9V center negative, 150 mA minimum.

devices.name: Riverside
devices.notes: Mono. Boost jack takes a footswitch for the post boost (or sends Favorite to another Strymon pedal); Expression jack also carries MIDI with the MIDI EXP cable. 250 mA minimum.

devices.name: Cloudburst
devices.notes: Single TRS in and out; rear switch picks mono-mono, mono-stereo or stereo-stereo (TRS splitter cables for stereo). EXP/MIDI jack takes an expression pedal, MiniSwitch, MultiSwitch Plus or TRS MIDI. 9V center negative, 250 mA minimum.

devices.name: Nightsky
devices.notes: Stereo in/out (Left alone for mono). EXP jack takes an expression pedal, MultiSwitch Plus or 1/4"-to-MIDI cable. 9V center negative, 300 mA minimum.

devices.name: Dyna Comp
devices.notes: 3.3-4 mA. 9V battery or 9V center-negative adapter.

devices.name: Carbon Copy
devices.notes: 26 mA stated (12 mA measured). 9V battery or ECB003 adapter (9V, center negative).

devices.name: Distortion+
devices.notes: About 2.5-3 mA. 9V battery or 9V center-negative adapter.

devices.name: Micro Amp
devices.notes: About 2.5-3 mA. 9V battery or 9V center-negative adapter.

devices.name: Analog Chorus
devices.notes: Second output is a dry Thru for a second amp (stereo-style setups). Buffered bypass. 13 mA.

devices.name: Ten Band EQ (Silver)
devices.notes: Needs 18V (ECB004 adapter, center negative) - it won't work right on 9V. Two outputs. 48 mA measured.

devices.name: Small Clone
devices.notes: 7-10 mA. 9V center negative.

devices.name: Deluxe Memory Man (Big Box)
devices.notes: Runs on 24V, not 9V - use the EHX 24DC-100 adapter. Sources disagree on plug polarity and size, so stick with the EHX supply. Effect Out plus a dry Direct Out.

devices.name: Holy Grail Nano
devices.notes: About 101-110 mA. 9.6V DC 200 mA adapter included (9V center negative).

devices.name: Canyon
devices.notes: Mono. Tap jack for an external tap switch. 150 mA; no battery. 9.6V DC 200 mA adapter included (center negative).

devices.name: Soul Food
devices.notes: 22 mA. 9V battery or 9.6V DC adapter (center negative).

devices.name: Pitch Fork
devices.notes: EXP jack for an expression pedal (pitch/glissando). 30 mA stated (25 mA measured). 9.6V DC adapter (center negative); the Pitch Fork+ is a different pedal (120 mA).

devices.name: Nano Big Muff Pi
devices.notes: About 3 mA. 9V center negative.

devices.name: Whammy 5
devices.notes: 5th generation Whammy. No dry output (earlier models had one). Under 265 mA stated (185 mA measured); 9V DC center negative.

devices.name: Centaur
devices.notes: 9V center negative (charge pump makes 18V inside, so don't feed it more than 9V). No published current draw for the original Centaur; reissue/clones list 30-100 mA. Bill Finnegan advised against multi-output supplies for the original.

devices.name: Colour Box V2
devices.notes: Preamp/DI. Combo XLR/1/4" input (pad works in XLR mode) and independent XLR and 1/4" outputs; can pass 48V phantom from a console. 193 mA; 9V center negative only, no battery.

devices.name: Kilt V2
devices.notes: Red Remote jack (TRS) toggles the G2 setting. 64 mA measured. 9V center negative, no battery.

devices.name: Julia V2
devices.notes: Top-mounted jacks. 100 mA minimum; 9V center negative.

devices.name: ARP-87
devices.notes: Tap jack for a normally-open momentary switch or master clock. 100 mA minimum (60 mA measured); 9V center negative, isolated supply recommended.

devices.name: Plumes
devices.notes: 25 mA. 9V center negative; don't run at higher voltages.

devices.name: Afterneath V3
devices.notes: Expression jack controls Drag (50k pedal; also takes 0-5V CV). 100 mA; 9V center negative, no battery.

devices.name: Hoof
devices.notes: Under 5 mA. 9V center negative.

devices.name: Palisades
devices.notes: 25 mA. 9V center negative.

devices.name: Data Corrupter
devices.notes: 26 mA. 9V center negative.

devices.name: Dispatch Master
devices.notes: Mono, no expression jack. 78 mA; 9V center negative.

devices.name: Compressor Plus
devices.notes: About 10 mA. 9V center negative.

devices.name: Tumnus
devices.notes: 20 mA. 9V only, center negative.

devices.name: BB Preamp
devices.notes: 6 mA. 9V center negative; up to 15V for more headroom.

devices.name: RC Booster V2
devices.notes: 6 mA. 9V center negative; up to 18V for more headroom.

devices.name: SP Compressor
devices.notes: 5 mA. 9V center negative; up to 18V.

devices.name: King of Tone
devices.notes: About 10 mA (6 mA off). 9V center negative (Boss PSA type); never more than 12V (relay).

devices.name: Jimi Hendrix Fuzz Face Mini
devices.notes: Under 5 mA (approximate). 9V battery or 9V center-negative adapter.

devices.name: Fuzz Factory
devices.notes: About 3 mA. 9V center negative.

devices.name: Full-drive FD-2 V2
devices.notes: About 10 mA. 9-18V DC, center negative (2.1mm).

devices.name: Sansamp Bass Driver Programmable
devices.notes: Programmable Bass Driver DI: effected XLR (takes phantom power) and 1/4" outputs plus an unaffected parallel output. About 7 mA measured; Tech 21 asks for a 9V supply of 100 mA minimum, center negative.

devices.name: Microtubes B7K Ultra
devices.notes: Bass preamp/DI with a balanced XLR output (cab sim switchable). 120 mA; regulated 9V center negative only. (The V2 Aux version adds a 3.5mm aux in/headphone jack.)

devices.name: DL4 Delay MkII
devices.notes: XLR mic input (no phantom). EXP/FS jack takes an expression pedal or two footswitches. Supplied adapter is 9V 500 mA, center negative (270 mA measured).

devices.name: HX Effects
devices.notes: Two control jacks work as expression inputs or amp channel switching outputs. Needs 9V DC, 2A bare minimum (3A supply, DC-3G); 2.5mm plug, center negative.

devices.name: DD-500 Digital Delay
devices.notes: CTL 1,2/EXP jack (TRS) takes two footswitches or an expression pedal. 4 AA batteries or BOSS PSA adapter (9V, center negative).

devices.name: DD-200 Digital Delay
devices.notes: 225 mA stated (175 mA measured). MIDI on 3.5mm TRS jacks. USB is for firmware updates only. 3 AA batteries or BOSS PSA adapter (9V, center negative).

devices.name: RV-6 Reverb
devices.notes: Stereo in/out; EXP jack for an expression pedal. BOSS PSA adapter: 9V DC, center negative.

devices.name: OC-5 Octave
devices.notes: Direct Out carries the dry signal. 60 mA stated (55 mA measured). BOSS PSA adapter: 9V DC, center negative.

devices.name: GE-7 Graphic Equalizer
devices.notes: 30 mA stated (8 mA measured). Battery or BOSS PSA adapter: 9V DC, center negative.

devices.name: NS-2 Noise Suppressor
devices.notes: Send/Return loop puts noisy pedals inside the suppressor. Has a 9V DC OUT jack for chaining power; daisy chains are drawn from the power jack instead. BOSS PSA adapter: 9V DC, center negative.

devices.name: TR-2 Tremolo
devices.notes: 25 mA stated (19 mA measured). BOSS PSA adapter: 9V DC, center negative.

devices.name: CE-2w Chorus (Waza Craft)
devices.notes: Output A/B for stereo. BOSS PSA adapter: 9V DC, center negative.

devices.name: DM-2w Delay (Waza Craft)

devices.notes: Phaser. 30 mA minimum. 9V DC center negative; Walrus recommends an isolated supply. (Jack list not confirmed; may have stereo outputs.)

devices.name: Descent
devices.notes: Mono in, mono or stereo out. Expression input and a Fav jack for a momentary switch. 130 mA minimum. 9V DC center negative; Walrus recommends an isolated supply.

devices.name: D&M Drive
devices.notes: Two circuits (boost + drive); TRS insert cables can split it into two pedals (not modeled). 55 mA. 9V center negative.

devices.name: Super Phat Mod
devices.notes: 10 mA. 9V center negative.

devices.name: Katana
devices.notes: Clean boost. Under 10 mA. 9V only (internal voltage doubler).

devices.name: Pantheon
devices.notes: 18 mA (19 mA at 18V). 9-18V DC, center negative.

devices.name: Tumnus Deluxe
devices.notes: About 70 mA. 9V only, center negative.

devices.name: Plexi-Drive
devices.notes: 22 mA (34 mA at 18V). 9-18V DC, center negative.

devices.name: Belle
devices.notes: 12 mA (15 mA at 18V). 9-18V DC, center negative.

devices.name: AC Booster
devices.notes: 6 mA. 9V center negative; up to 15V.

devices.name: SL Drive
devices.notes: 5 mA. 9V center negative; up to 18V.

devices.name: Supa-Trem
devices.notes: Original Supa-Trem (ST-1). No published current draw found (the Supa-Trem Jr draws about 30 mA, the stereo Supa-Trem2 about 50 mA). 9V center negative.

devices.name: Belle Epoch
devices.notes: Tape-echo preamp/delay. About 60-61 mA (one listing says 100 mA). 9-18V DC, center negative (18V for max authenticity).

devices.name: Dirty Little Secret
devices.notes: 5 mA at 9V, 7 mA at 18V. 9-18V DC, center negative.

devices.name: Echorec
devices.notes: No tap, expression or MIDI jacks. Listings say 60 mA or 100 mA (100 used here). 9-18V DC, center negative.

devices.name: PitchFactor
devices.notes: Stereo in/out with guitar/line level switches. Expression and Aux Switch jacks. MIDI In and Out/Thru (5-pin DIN). USB-B for updates/editor. 9V DC CENTER POSITIVE, 2.5mm plug - use the Eventide supply; about 400 mA, up to 500 mA at startup.

devices.name: ModFactor
devices.notes: Stereo in/out with guitar/line level switches. Expression and Aux Switch jacks. MIDI In and Out/Thru (5-pin DIN). USB-B for updates/editor. 9V DC CENTER POSITIVE, 2.5mm plug - use the Eventide supply; about 400 mA, up to 500 mA at startup.

devices.name: Blackhole
devices.notes: Stereo in/out (guitar or line level). EXP jack takes an expression pedal, aux switches or TRS MIDI. Mini-USB for updates and USB MIDI. 9V DC center negative, 500 mA.

devices.name: UltraTap
devices.notes: Stereo in/out (guitar or line level). EXP jack takes an expression pedal, aux switches or TRS MIDI. Mini-USB for updates and USB MIDI. 9V DC center negative, 500 mA.

devices.name: MicroPitch Delay
devices.notes: Stereo in/out (guitar or line level). EXP jack takes an expression pedal, aux switches or TRS MIDI. Mini-USB for updates and USB MIDI. 9V DC center negative, 500 mA.

devices.name: Max
devices.notes: Stereo in/out (input 2 / output 2 for stereo); USB-C for updates and USB MIDI. Isolated 9V DC center negative, 400 mA minimum.

devices.name: Astra
devices.notes: Stereo in/out (input 2 / output 2 for stereo); USB-C for updates and USB MIDI. Isolated 9V DC center negative, 400 mA minimum.

devices.name: Hedra
devices.notes: EXP jack (TRS) takes an expression pedal, tap/preset switch, or MIDI via the Meris MIDI I/O box. Under 150 mA; 9V DC center negative. Stereo in/out on TRS jacks (TS for mono) - confirm against the manual.

devices.name: LVX
devices.notes: Stereo in/out on separate jacks, instrument/line level switch. EXP jack (can also carry MIDI). 5-pin MIDI In/Out. USB-C for firmware only. 9V DC center negative, 300 mA minimum. Early units could have power-up trouble with some third-party supplies (fixed on units shipped from Nov 2022).

devices.name: Enzo X
devices.notes: Stereo in/out on separate jacks, instrument/line level switch. EXP jack (can also carry MIDI). 5-pin MIDI In/Out. USB-C for firmware only. 9V DC center negative, 300 mA minimum.

devices.name: Ottobit Jr.
devices.notes: EXP jack (TRS) takes an expression pedal, tap/preset switch, or MIDI via the Meris MIDI I/O box. Under 150 mA; 9V DC center negative. Stereo in/out on TRS jacks (TS for mono) - confirm against the manual.

devices.name: C4 Synth
devices.notes: Stereo in/out; Control Input (TRS); Mini-USB carries MIDI from a computer or controller. 165 mA minimum, isolated 9V DC center negative.

devices.name: Collider
devices.notes: Stereo in/out; Control Input (TRS) for an expression pedal or Source Audio Tap/Dual switch; MIDI In/Thru (5-pin DIN); USB. 9V DC center negative (Source Audio recommends an isolated supply). Listings say 200-300 mA (300 used here).

devices.name: Ventris
devices.notes: Stereo in/out; Control Input (TRS) for an expression pedal or Source Audio Tap/Dual switch; MIDI In/Thru (5-pin DIN); USB. 9V DC center negative (Source Audio recommends an isolated supply). Current not confirmed; 300 mA assumed from the Collider (which combines the Ventris and Nemesis).

devices.name: Nemesis
devices.notes: Stereo in/out; Control Input (TRS) for an expression pedal or Source Audio Tap/Dual switch; MIDI In/Thru (5-pin DIN); USB. 9V DC center negative (Source Audio recommends an isolated supply). Current not confirmed; 300 mA assumed from the Collider.

devices.name: HX Stomp XL
devices.notes: Stereo in/out (line/instrument switchable), stereo FX loop (TRS send, stereo returns), EXP/FS jack, MIDI, USB audio. 9V DC 3A supply included; same power needs as HX Stomp.

devices.name: HX One
devices.notes: Stereo in/out; the R jacks can work as a mono send/return (Insert mode). USB-C is MIDI/data only (no audio). 500 mA; 9V center negative.

devices.name: M5
devices.notes: Stereo in/out, expression jack, MIDI. 350 mA; 9V DC 500 mA supply included (center negative). No battery.

devices.name: DL4 Delay
devices.notes: Original DL4: stereo in/out, expression jack. Runs on a 9V AC adapter (Line 6 PX-2, 1200 mA) or 4 C batteries - not a standard 9V DC pedal supply. Draws about 175-250 mA.

devices.name: Helix LT
devices.notes: Mains powered (IEC cable), so no pedal-supply jack is listed. Two FX loops, XLR and 1/4" outputs, EXP 2 jack, MIDI, USB audio. Also has AES/EBU and L6 LINK (not modeled). Jack list not checked against the manual.

devices.name: G1x Four
devices.notes: Built-in expression pedal. Combined line/headphone output (stereo). 9V DC center negative (Zoom AD-16, 500 mA), 4 AA batteries, or USB bus power.

devices.name: Vapor Trail
devices.notes: Analog delay. About 11 mA. 9V battery or 9-18V regulated DC, center negative (the Vapor Trail Deluxe is different: 150 mA).

devices.name: 805 Overdrive
devices.notes: 4.5 mA. 9V battery or 9-18V regulated DC, center negative.

devices.name: Timmy V2
devices.notes: About 4 mA. 9V battery or Boss-style 9V center-negative adapter.

devices.name: Preamp
devices.notes: About 50 mA. 9V DC center negative.

devices.name: Sweet Honey Overdrive
devices.notes: About 5 mA. 9V battery or 7.5-18V DC, 2.1mm center negative.

devices.name: Dark Star
devices.notes: Pad reverb with an expression input. 60 mA (Dark Star V2 figure; the later Dark Star Stereo draws about 350 mA). 9V center negative.

devices.name: Echosystem
devices.notes: Dual-engine delay. Control port takes an expression pedal, tap switch, CV or MIDI. 300 mA; 9V DC, 2.1mm center negative. Stereo jacks not confirmed against the manual.

devices.name: Reverb
devices.notes: Stereo in/out. Universal Control Port (1/4") takes expression, tap, CV, external audio or MIDI. 300 mA; 9V DC, 2.1mm center negative.

devices.name: ParaEQ
devices.notes: 85 mA (version 7). 9-18V DC, center negative (older versions draw 75-130 mA depending on voltage).

devices.name: Polara
devices.notes: Stereo reverb (true bypass). 75 mA typical. DigiTech PS0913DC adapter (9V DC, 1.3 A); 9V DC center negative.

devices.name: Bass Whammy
devices.notes: MIDI In (5-pin DIN). About 265 mA. DigiTech PS0913DC adapter (9V DC, 1.3 A); 9V DC center negative.

devices.name: Whammy Ricochet
devices.notes: 235 mA typical; the manual asks for at least 300 mA from a shared supply. External adapter only (no battery). DigiTech PS0913DC adapter (9V DC, 1.3 A); 9V DC center negative.

devices.name: MC6 Pro
devices.notes: MIDI controller. Omniports work as TRS MIDI out, expression input or aux switch input (don't feed them power). 250 mA, 350 mA using the relay ports; 9-12V DC center negative, or USB bus power. Omniport count not confirmed.

devices.name: MC8
devices.notes: MIDI controller. Four 1/4" Omniports: TRS MIDI out, expression input or aux switch input. 250 mA at 9V DC center negative; can also run on USB bus power or phantom power over a 7-pin MIDI cable.

devices.name: Pedal Power Digital
devices.notes: 4 isolated 400 mA outputs: two fixed 9V, two switchable 9/12V (1600 mA total). Mains powered. Discontinued.

devices.name: Pedal Power 3 Plus
devices.notes: 12 isolated 500 mA outputs: ten 9V, two switchable 9/12V. X-LINK ports for expansion. Mains powered (100-240V AC).

devices.name: DC7
devices.notes: 7 isolated outputs, each 660 mA at 9V, 500 mA at 12V, 400 mA at 15V, 330 mA at 18V. Not confirmed which outputs have voltage switches; modeled as all switchable. Mains powered.

devices.name: 1 Spot Pro CS6
devices.notes: 6 isolated outputs, 1600 mA total: two 9V 500 mA, two 9/12V 200 mA, two 9/18V 100 mA. Listings disagree on which of outputs 3-6 are which - check the labels on the unit.

devices.name: 1 Spot Pro CS12
devices.notes: 12 isolated outputs: 1-2 18V 100 mA; 3-6 9/12V 100 mA; 7 9V or variable 4-9V 100 mA; 8-9 9V 250 mA; 10-11 9V 500 mA; 12 is 9V AC 800 mA (for Line 6/DigiTech AC pedals - Signal Flow treats it as DC). About 2900-3000 mA total. Mains powered.

devices.name: Aetos
devices.notes: 8 isolated 9V outputs: six at 100 mA, two high-current (250 mA per most listings; some say 300 mA). Mains powered, with a courtesy AC outlet.

devices.name: Iso Brick
devices.notes: 10 isolated outputs: 9V at 100/100/300/300/450/450 mA, two 18V at 250 mA, two variable 6-15V at 250 mA (the knob is continuous; 6/9/12/15 offered here). Runs from an 18V 2A adapter.

devices.name: Strobostomp HD
devices.notes: 80 mA. 9V center negative. Jack list not confirmed (it may also have a USB port for updates).

devices.name: Pitchblack
devices.notes: Original PB-01. No published current draw found. Has a 9V DC power-through output for another pedal; daisy chains are drawn from the power jack instead.

devices.name: Cali76 Compact Deluxe
devices.notes: Compressor. 100 mA. 9-18V DC, 2.1mm center negative (18V for more headroom); no battery.

devices.name: Hermida Zendrive
devices.notes: About 13 mA. 9V center negative.

devices.name: TO800 Vintage Tube Overdrive
devices.notes: No published current draw found. 9V battery or Behringer PSU-SB adapter (9V, center negative).

devices.name: MT-2w Metal Zone (Waza Craft)
devices.notes: 35 mA. BOSS PSA adapter: 9V DC, center negative.
